featured_reviews.name: Divya
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently attended a wedding at Kora Kendar, and while the overall ambience was pleasant, I was disappointed with the lack of proper washroom facilities. Having previously visited for a garba event a few years ago, I expected improvements in this area, but unfortunately, it was still a major inconvenience.

The venue relies on portable restrooms, commonly known as porta-potties, which are known for their discomfort and lack of cleanliness. This arrangement was highly inconvenient, especially during a wedding where guests require comfortable and hygienic washroom facilities. The absence of proper washroom amenities significantly affected the overall experience.

However, it's worth noting that Kora Kendar does excel in terms of ambiance. The atmosphere created for the event was enjoyable, and the management seemed to have put effort into creating a pleasant environment for the guests. The overall decor and arrangements were satisfactory, contributing to the positive aspects of the venue.

Despite the shortcomings in washroom facilities, Kora Kendar may still be a suitable choice for events like garba or weddings, provided that alternative arrangements are made for washroom facilities. It would greatly enhance the overall experience and ensure the comfort of guests.

featured_reviews.review_text: Visited Taste of Konkan in Borivali and had a wonderful experience. We tried the Kolhapuri Mutton Thali, Surmai Fish Thali and Stuffed Bombil Fry and every dish was packed with authentic flavours. featured_reviews.name: Aditi Prabhu
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ambiance: Simple, soothing, with both indoor and outdoor sitting. Located at Babhai Naka, Borivali.

Our experience: We went in for dinner on a weekday. The place was largely empty and quiet. Took them 20 mins to take our first order despite having only 4 tables being served including ours.

We ordered the following dishes:
• Bombil Fry: The coating was way too thicker and the bombil hardly present. Could barely taste the bombil.
• Prawn koliwada: Again the coating overpowered the flavor of prawns.
• Bangda Thali and Ravas thali: Both thalis were exactly the same with the same fish curry, a tiny serving of prawn preparation, another tiny serving of matki usal in one thali and another random gravy in the bangda thalis. We weren't asked about our preferences for wada, chapati or bhakri. So one thali came with wadas, the other with chapati and on placing the order the third, we were asked about our preference for chapati or bhakri then informed bhakri is probabaly over. So we okayed chapati but were served wadas.

We also ordered another plate of extra chapati which they didnt have and offered wadas but none reached our table even after 2 reminders.

Finally we finished our meals and then asked for the bill which had the extra cost of wadas which we ordered and never recieved and also for the wada in thali which we weren't informed were charged extra but were given as they didnt have chapatis or bhakris.

They did change the bill on being informed.

We also asked for regular water which we recieved almost at the end of the meal after being reminded for the fifth time.

Service: Slow, and confused even when there were just 2-3 tables with people only.

While we understand it was end if the day and hence the food there was over and also probably that is why there were many errors & delays in service. But the overall experience and food were not upto the mark or hype.

featured_reviews.name: anish tatkare
featured_reviews.review_text:
Today I went to this hotel with my family for a dinner.
The hotel's name is only Taste of Konkan, but there is no taste of Konkan anywhere. I'm from Konkan. So don't fool people by talking about the taste of Konkan.
The chicken thali only had the taste of Elaichi and nothing else. Same with Prawns thali too. Bombil Bhaji was of a lower standard than Onion Bhaji.

featured_reviews.name: Tejas Khandalekar
featured_reviews.review_text: We enjoyed the food. Prawns thali and Kombadi vade was great options which we enjoyed. Prawns curry, Prawns masala was so delicious. Sol kadhi was also tasty. In kombadi vade, curry was perfectly Malvani taste and vade was crunchy and yummy. However, bombil bhaji (pakoda) was not that great. Overall food was good, ambience was also good

Kora Kendra Ground 3 – A Spacious & Beautifully Decorated Wedding Venue

Kora Kendra Ground 3 is one of those places that instantly puts you in a celebratory mood. The space is huge, making it perfect for grand weddings, receptions, and big family functions. What really stands out is how beautifully the venue is decorated — elegant lighting, well-planned layout, and a warm ambience that makes every moment feel special.

There’s plenty of room for seating, dining, and even those big baraat entries! Parking is usually manageable, and the overall organisation feels smooth and guest-friendly.

If you’re looking for a spacious, classy, and well-maintained venue for a memorable event, Kora Kendra Ground 3 definitely delivers. ✨

Used to be one of the very well maintained joggers track till about 2019 however the park is not being maintained now.
You can see a lot of debris and construction materials lying around.
The park is still used by local for jogging, walking and relaxation by senior citizens.
It is still amongst the good tracks for fitness enthusiast in this area.

You do have place to sit around the pond incase you just want to enjoy your time with family and friends.

featured_reviews.name: Falguni P
featured_reviews.review_text:
Kids Friendly place.
This place is divided into different sections, the entry is free.

*Fish park - this park is quite big and has 3 gates,
The first half has fish tanks, selfie point and a fountain
Currently there are only few fishes, the fountain is shut and the empty tanks are not maintained well (due to COVID)

*The cricket ground - usually there is local cricket match on weekends, chairs are provided for audience.

*Kids play area- there are slides, swings, and play area for kids.

*Open Gym- they have a gym area near the second gate, which is currently closed for public, equipments are mainted nicely.

*Walking / jogging track - there is a long walking and jogging track around the park, local residents usually come visit for morning and evening walks

*Accessibility - park is partially Accessibility as there are stairs in some parts of the park. This place is ideal for kids, family and senior citizens.
The fish park gate is accessible but to reach the other area it is ideal to use the second gate which has a slope.

featured_reviews.name: Chef Vaidehi Pathare
featured_reviews.review_text:
It has been more than twenty years since I first visited Silver Coin Family Restaurant and Bar with my family, and it continues to remain a special place for us in Borivali. It is one of those restaurants in Borivali that continues to feel like home because of its food and hospitality.

This time, we began our meal with a bowl of Chicken Manchow Soup. It was served hot, and I enjoyed how it had a bold, flavorful taste without being overpowering. For starters, we ordered Veg Seekh Kebab, Mutton Seekh Kebab, and Chicken Pahadi Tikka. The Veg Seekh Kebab was nice, cooked well, and had the perfect earthy flavour. The Mutton Seekh Kebab was outstanding. It had a silky texture, was well-seasoned, and paired beautifully with the chutney. It was not chewy at all, and I really liked how smooth it felt with every bite. The Chicken Pahadi Tikka was equally good. The chicken was tender, juicy, and cooked with a light smokiness that made it enjoyable.

For the mains, I ordered Jeera Rice with Dal Tadka. The dal had a nice garlic tempering with the right amount of cumin, and together with the rice it felt wholesome and comforting. The Chicken Tikka Masala came with soft pieces of chicken in a thick gravy that had a good balance of spices. It went really well with the Tandoori Roti, which was crisp on the edges and soft in the middle. The Chicken Triple Schezwan Fried Rice was the last dish. It was mildly spiced, had a smoky taste from the wok, and the flavours were balanced in a way that made it enjoyable till the last bite.

As we were about to finish, we couldn’t resist ordering the Chicken Masala Lollipop, which has always been a family favorite. It was crispy, spicy, and coated beautifully with sauce. It was the highlight of the evening. The chicken inside was fresh and well-cooked, and every bite reminded me why I have loved this dish here for years.

The food at Silver Coin Family Restaurant and Bar is consistently good, and the staff make the experience even better. They are polite, attentive, and always welcoming. This restaurant is more of a family place, and the presence of a bar only adds to the variety without taking away from its warm atmosphere.

Ratings:
Quality - 4/5
Quantity - 4/5
Service - 4.2/5
Price - ₹5000 for 8 people

For more mouthwatering food content, don’t forget to follow @chefvaidehipathare on Instagram!

featured_reviews.name: stephen nazareth
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing to share my deep disappointment regarding the experience my group of 10 had at your restaurant on 08/05/2026.We arrived late in the evening, well before your stated last order time of 11:45 PM, but were met with significant confusion and poor service.Despite the restaurant being busy, the staff seemed completely unorganised regarding table availability for a group of our size. More concerningly, one particular staff member was openly unfriendly and ignored us repeatedly. When we finally spoke to them, we were dismissed with a blunt statement that no space was available, which contradicted the effort of other staff who were trying to assist us.As a customer, I expected a more professional and welcoming attitude, especially in a service industry. This experience was a poor reflection of your establishment and ruined what was meant to be a pleasant family gathering.Despite arriving before your 11:45 PM last order time, we were treated as an inconvenience. Most concerning was the lack of empathy for the elderly members of our group. Even after a large group vacated a table, your staff left it uncleaned for a long period while our elderly family members were forced to wait standing up.Once seated, the service was aggressive and rude. Staff were literally throwing silverware and plates onto the table to set up. We were repeatedly told that the "cooks have to go home," creating an environment where we felt rushed and unwelcome. As customers arriving within operating hours, it is not our "mistake" to expect a professional dining experience.Your kitchen staff clearly takes pride in their work, but the front-of-house team’s behavior ruined our evening. The service staff himself admitted that people love food here and not the service. I Hope the service for the first customer who dines get well treatment then why the last is always bad  because we choose the late time

Sorry not recommending and not coming again

featured_reviews.name: Vaishali Patel
featured_reviews.review_text:
The food here was absolutely outstanding—truly a paradise for food lovers. Every bite was rich in flavor and made with so much care that it genuinely felt like home-cooked food filled with love. Nothing I’ve tasted elsewhere even comes close to this experience.
The service was equally amazing—warm, attentive, and welcoming, which made the entire visit even more special. From the moment we walked in until the very end, everything was perfect.
Hands down, this is the best, best, best restaurant in the whole multiverse 😄 If you’re looking for unforgettable food, heartfelt service, and a place that leaves you smiling, this is it. Highly, highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Gajanand Yadav
featured_reviews.review_text:
After doing great with their Borivali outlet, Silver coin has come up with another venture in Thane. A proper fine dine place for families, this place has a huge and decent seating, accompanied by a banquet hall as well. It looks deceptively small from outside, but the ambience inside is elegant. Had been with my family for dinner on Monday and had an amazing experience. Tried a few of their veg cuisines which Included Indian , Chinese and Continental. Here's a list of a few of them :

*Appetizers
Afghani bharwa aloo: Potatoes stuffed with panner and Frey fruits.
Popiah: A vegetable Thai spring roll
Chilly basil paneer.

*Mocktails:
Sunrise: A refreshing drink with orange and like juice
Strawberry delight: A thick shake with strawberry cream.
Green cooler : Pineapple, mint and lemon fused nicely.

*Mains :
Vegetable lasagna: Authentic veg lasagna beautifully presented with parmesan cheese on it.
Mapo tofu: Tofu with veggies in red gravy.
